$comment: FuelPay colour system. Every categorical/status set here is verified by scripts/validate-palettes.mjs, which exits non-zero on any failure. Re-run it after ANY change to these values.

brand.$comment: Identity only. Never used to signal a status — that separation is the whole point, since the previous system had brand, ok and info all set to the same teal.

interactive.$comment: Links and primary controls. Two values because the light navy is unreadable on a dark field once antd derives hover states from it.

status.$comment: THREE hues, not four. A four-step traffic-light ramp cannot pass colourblind validation: the amber pair collapses to deltaE 1.3 under deuteranopia — they are metamers. 'watch' and 'low' therefore share a hue and differ by FILL WEIGHT (soft tint vs solid) plus their always-present text label. See reports/palette-validation.txt.

chart.$comment: The load trace is achromatic on purpose. Fuel and load are drawn in separate stacked grids and never overlap, so a second hue was decoration — and dropping it removes a pair from the colourblind pairlist entirely.

focus.$comment: Amber, so the focus ring is unmistakably ours and never collides with a status colour.
